hook: Prodia Diagnostic raih dana Rp62,74 miliar lewat IPO di pasar modal RI
fact:
Direktur Utama PT Prodia Diagnostic Line Tbk (PRDL) Cristina Sandjaja diwawancarai media seusai seremoni Initial Public Offering (IPO)
Main Hall Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI), Jakarta, Kamis (09/07/2026). (ANTARA/M Heriyanto)
